versos.grego: Ὁ πρεσβύτερος ἐκλεκτῇ κυρίᾳ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτῆς, οὓς ἐγὼ ἀγαπῶ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καὶ οὐκ ἐγὼ μόνος ἀλλὰ καὶ πάντες οἱ ἐγνωκότες τὴν ἀλήθειαν,

controles.web: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all those who know the truth;
controles.kjv: The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth;
controles.livre: O ancião, à senhora eleita, e a seus filhos, aos quais eu amo em verdade; e não somente eu, mas também todos os que têm conhecido a verdade;

versos.grego: διὰ τὴν ἀλήθειαν τὴν μένουσαν ἐν ἡμῖν, καὶ μεθ’ ἡμῶν ἔσται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.

controles.web: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:
controles.kjv: For the truth’s sake, which dwelleth in us, and shall be with us for ever.
controles.livre: Por causa da verdade que está em nós, e estará para sempre conosco.

versos.grego: ἔσται μεθ’ ἡμῶν χάρις ἔλεος εἰρήνη παρὰ Θεοῦ Πατρός, καὶ παρὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Υἱοῦ τοῦ Πατρός, ἐν ἀληθείᾳ καὶ ἀγάπῃ.

controles.web: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
controles.kjv: Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.
controles.livre: Graça, misericórdia, e paz de Deus Pai, e do Senhor Jesus Cristo, o Filho do Pai, seja convosco em verdade e amor.

versos.grego: Ἐχάρην λίαν ὅτι εὕρηκα ἐκ τῶν τέκνων σου περιπατοῦντας ἐν ἀληθείᾳ, καθὼς ἐντολὴν ἐλάβομεν παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός.

controles.web: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.
controles.kjv: I rejoiced greatly that I found of thy children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father.
controles.livre: Muito me alegrei por eu ter encontrado alguns de teus filhos andando na verdade, assim como recebemos o mandamento do Pai.

versos.grego: καὶ νῦν ἐρωτῶ σε, κυρία, οὐχ ὡς ἐντολὴν γράφων σοι καινὴν, ἀλλὰ ἣν εἴχαμεν ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἀγαπῶμεν ἀλλήλους.

controles.web: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
controles.kjv: And now I beseech thee, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto thee, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.
controles.livre: E agora, senhora, eu te rogo, não como te escrevendo um novo mandamento, mas o que tivemos desde o princípio: que nos amemos uns aos outros.

versos.grego: καὶ αὕτη ἐστὶν ἡ ἀγάπη, ἵνα περιπατῶμεν κατὰ τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ· αὕτη ἡ ἐντολή ἐστιν, καθὼς ἠκούσατε ἀπ’ ἀρχῆς, ἵνα ἐν αὐτῇ περιπατῆτε.

controles.web: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.
controles.kjv: And this is love, that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as ye have heard from the beginning, ye should walk in it.
controles.livre: E este é o amor: que andemos segundo seus mandamentos. E este é o mandamento, como já ouvistes desde o princípio: que nele andeis.

versos.grego: ὅτι πολλοὶ πλάνοι ἐξῆλθον εἰς τὸν κόσμον, οἱ μὴ ὁμολογοῦντες Ἰησοῦν Χριστὸν ἐρχόμενον ἐν σαρκί· οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ πλάνος καὶ ὁ ἀντίχριστος.

controles.web: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.
controles.kjv: For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist.
controles.livre: Porque muitos enganadores têm surgido no mundo que não declaram que Jesus Cristo veio em carne. Este é o enganador e o anticristo.

versos.grego: βλέπετε ἑαυτούς, ἵνα μὴ ἀπολέσητε ἃ ἠργασάμεθα, ἀλλὰ μισθὸν πλήρη ἀπολάβητε.

controles.web: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.
controles.kjv: Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward.
controles.livre: Vigiai por vós mesmos, para que não percamos o que trabalhamos; mas sim que recebamos uma recompensa completa.

versos.grego: πᾶς ὁ προάγων καὶ μὴ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ τοῦ Χριστοῦ Θεὸν οὐκ ἔχει· ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ διδαχῇ, οὗτος καὶ τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τὸν Υἱὸν ἔχει.

controles.web: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching, the same has both the Father and the Son.
controles.kjv: Whosoever transgresseth, and abideth not in the doctrine of Christ, hath not God. He that abideth in the doctrine of Christ, he hath both the Father and the Son.
controles.livre: Todo aquele que vai além e não continua na doutrina de Cristo não tem a Deus; quem continua na doutrina de Cristo tem tanto ao Pai quanto ao Filho.

versos.grego: εἴ τις ἔρχεται πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ταύτην τὴν διδαχὴν οὐ φέρει, μὴ λαμβάνετε αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκίαν, καὶ χαίρειν αὐτῷ μὴ λέγετε·

controles.web: If anyone comes to you, and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,
controles.kjv: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:
controles.livre: Se alguém vem a vós, e não traz esta doutrina, não recebais em vossa casa, nem o saudeis.

versos.grego: ὁ λέγων γὰρ αὐτῷ χαίρειν κοινωνεῖ τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ τοῖς πονηροῖς.

controles.web: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil works.
controles.kjv: For he that biddeth him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds.
controles.livre: Porque quem o saúda compartilha com suas más obras.

versos.grego: Πολλὰ ἔχων ὑμῖν γράφειν οὐκ ἐβουλήθην διὰ χάρτου καὶ μέλανος, ἀλλὰ ἐλπίζω γενέσθαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ στόμα πρὸς στόμα λαλῆσαι, ἵνα ἡ χαρὰ ἡμῶν πεπληρωμένη ᾖ.

controles.web: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.
controles.kjv: Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full.
controles.livre: Muitas coisas eu tenho que vos escrever, porém não eu quis fazê-lo com papel e tinta; mas espero vir a vós, e vos falar face a face, para que nossa alegria seja completa.

versos.grego: Ἀσπάζεταί σε τὰ τέκνα τῆς ἀδελφῆς σου τῆς ἐκλεκτῆς.

controles.web: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
controles.kjv: The children of thy elect sister greet thee. Amen.
controles.livre: Os filhos de tua irmã, a eleita, te saúdam. Amém.
